primary_outcome: the statement printed by /app/tools/ddbill_run.py gives every container's stage figures, amount, discount and net and the invoice total as tariff rules DT-3 give them

obligations.contribution: merchant stage starts on the gate-out date; a stage's days run from its first day through its last (or the cut-off) with both ends counted

authority.anchor: A stage's days are the dates from its first day through its last day

separability.rationale: days set the free-time window and every chargeable day, hence amounts, discount and total

obligations.discriminating_instance: boxes gated out and returned on the discharge day, and stays of one to four hundred days, running and ended
obligations.wrong_but_plausible: date difference without the first day; merchant stage from the day after gate-out (shipped)

obligations.contribution: terminal free days are used one per working day (not a weekend or port holiday) and not on a closure day; none means the day before the first day

authority.anchor: free days are used one per working day

separability.rationale: the last free day decides which days are chargeable

obligations.discriminating_instance: discharges on a Thursday or Friday before a weekend and a holiday, with a closure inside free time
obligations.wrong_but_plausible: calendar days (shipped); weekends skipped but holidays or closures counted

obligations.contribution: chargeable days are the stage's days after its last free day, closure days left out at the terminal only; weekends and holidays after free time are charged

authority.anchor: A stage's chargeable days are its days after its last free day

separability.rationale: the count and the first chargeable day feed the tier charge and the scale choice

obligations.discriminating_instance: closures after free time at the terminal and during the merchant stage; a holiday after free time
obligations.wrong_but_plausible: stage days less free days (shipped); drop weekends after free time; drop closures in the merchant stage

obligations.contribution: a stage is priced on the scale of the revision in force on its first chargeable day; before the contract's earliest effective date the rules give no rule and the latest revision stays

authority.anchor: the revision in force on the stage's first chargeable day

separability.rationale: the scale sets every stage amount

obligations.discriminating_instance: a stage whose first chargeable day falls between two revisions, on an effective date, and before the earliest
obligations.wrong_but_plausible: latest revision always (shipped); the earliest revision or an error when none is in force (natural over-repair)

obligations.contribution: each chargeable day is charged at the rate of the tier that takes it; tiers are not retroactive

separability.rationale: the tier charge is the stage amount

obligations.discriminating_instance: stays ending one day short of, on, and one day past each tier boundary of a five-tier scale
obligations.wrong_but_plausible: every day at the rate of the tier the last day reaches (shipped); off-by-one boundary

obligations.contribution: the discount is the contract percentage of the stages' charges rounded half up; for a container with a running stage the rules give no rule (an accrual is not a charge) and today's truncated percentage of the repaired amount stays

authority.anchor: A container's discount is its contract's discount percentage

separability.rationale: the discount sets the net and the total

obligations.discriminating_instance: returned containers whose amount times percentage leaves 0, 49, 50 and 99 hundredths; running containers leaving 50 to 99 hundredths
obligations.wrong_but_plausible: truncation everywhere (shipped); half up everywhere, or a discount on the ended stages only (natural over-repairs)

obligations.contribution: section 7 keys, container order, null merchant stage

universal_rule.anchor: Each rule applies to every job inside the limits of rule 1.4

silence.anchor: Where the rules give no rule for a value the package works out

named_cases.anchor: where a rule needs the revision in force on such a day
Where a rule needs the charge of a running stage

coverage_envelope.anchor: Jobs of one to three hundred containers under one to twenty contracts will be run

seeds: solution/jobgen.py SEED (authoring only; graded jobs are sealed files)

restrictions.statement: leave the driver alone: the file you leave at that path must be byte-for-byte the one you were given

exact_output_requirements.rationale: the statement lists containers in job order

authority_anchor.anchor: an exact half cent is rounded up
